data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'az-zaḥ, which means 'to exalt or glorify'. This name signifies the noble and exalted qualities of a child. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the use of this name instills a sense of dignity and respect for the child. The name Azah carries the meaning “Noble, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azah usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
